name: hedera-lending-market
description: Collateralized lending market on Hedera: supply and borrow an HTS stable asset against HBAR collateral, with Pyth-powered pricing, SaucerSwap liquidation swaps, and an HCS activity feed.

instructions: +Fill in your Hedera testnet credentials: copy .env.example to .env
Fund the deployer account from the Hedera Portal faucet
Seed the SaucerSwap pool: {pm} run bootstrap

envVars.description: Your Hedera testnet account ID (0.0.XXXXXX) — pays for deployment and becomes the HTS token treasury
Private key for the account above (ECDSA hex or DER — never commit this)
Optional — WalletConnect project ID so HashPack can connect through RainbowKit
